## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
hdr <- read_csv(here("week4", "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                na = c("", "NA", ".."))
```

```{r}
dim(hdr)
names(hdr)[1:10]
names(hdr)[str_detect(names(hdr), "gii")]
```

```{r}
gii <- hdr %>%
  dplyr::select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)

head(gii)
summary(gii$gii_diff)

world <- st_read(here("week4", "world_countries.geojson"))

names(world)
head(world)
st_crs(world)$epsg
```
```{r}

world <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(ISO, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c"))

head(world)


world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(gii, by = "iso3")

dim(world_gii)


sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))


gii %>%
  filter(!iso3 %in% world$iso3) %>%
  dplyr::select(iso3, country)


world %>%
  filter(COUNTRY == "Namibia") %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```
```{r}
gii %>%
  arrange(gii_diff) %>%
  head(10)


gii %>%
  filter(gii_diff > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(gii_diff))


tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gii_diff",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-brewer.rd_bu",
                                               midpoint = 0,
                                               value.na = "grey85",
                                               label.na = "No data"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Change in GII\n2019 − 2010"),
              col = "white",
              lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_title("Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019") +
  tm_credits("Negative = less inequality. Source: UNDP HDR 2025",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))
```
```{r}
tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gii_diff",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                breaks = c(-0.6, -0.15, -0.10, -0.05, -0.02, 0, 0.02, 0.3),
                values = "-brewer.rd_bu",
                midpoint = 0,
                value.na = "grey85",
                label.na = "No data"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Change in GII\n2019 − 2010"),
              col = "white",
              lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_title("Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019") +
  tm_credits("Negative = less inequality. Source: UNDP HDR 2025",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))
```
